sources.title: Code Général des Impôts (General Tax Code), official 2023 edition
sources.institution: Ministère des Finances / Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI)
sources.coverage: VAT standard rate (Art. 230); zero-rated exports; consumption tax (taxe de consommation) on 10 product categories with explicit HS codes for several (Art. 258, 261-265)
sources.notes: Adopted by law n°2019-018 of 29 April 2019, official version January 2023, incorporating amendments through Loi de Finances 2022 (LFI.2022). Downloaded directly from the official Ministère des Finances portal (finances.gov.mr), text-based PDF (168 pages, not scanned).
